desc: Read the input T and process each test case.
For each test case, read N and the array A.
Implement the Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree) for rank queries and updates.
Maintain `head` pointer to the current first element.
Use `pos` dictionary and `ptr` pointers to efficiently find the next occurrence of the head value.
Calculate swaps needed to bring the next occurrence to position 1.
Count the length of the consecutive block of identical values.
Update costs (swaps + delete) and remove elements from the Fenwick Tree.
Update `head` to the next remaining element.
Handle edge cases (e.g., N=0, single element).
Print results for all test cases.
